process.durations_s.crystal_harvesting.note: Seconds per mounted crystal, not per plate (see process.duration_basis). Deployment data: "a mean mount time of 35 s (103 crystals per hour) and a median of 30 s (120 crystals per hour)"; range from "mounting rates of 100-240 crystals per hour" (15-36 s). Per mount attempt: 86% of mounts were judged a success, so time per successful crystal is higher (~41 s at the mean). A plate's harvest time is this x the crystals harvested from it, which the workflow sets. Includes plunge-cooling into a puck in LN2: the paper defines mount duration as drop arrival to the user leaving it, and reports "the time taken to fill a 16-sample puck" falling "to 10 min from 60-80 min" (37.5 s/crystal). The Shifter itself (an X-Y stage) does not cool; there is no separate cryo_cooling step to add.
